text: "How this cabinet plays", under the reels, gives its win model and what each feature is worth.
Won something? The Gamble offers double or nothing on the turn of a scale, before the win is banked.
Machines, in the header, changes cabinet. There are {cabinets}, and they are {cabinets} games rather than {cabinets} themes.
The Ledger, under More, shows what this cabinet has paid you next to what it pays.
Buy a feature, in the header, sells one outright. The price is set from what that feature pays.
Enough of one treasure stops the reels to ask what the seam does. Gilding pays most after a win.
